subject: BlueHarbor initial namespace seed & access kickoff
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BlueHarbor initial namespace seed & access kickoff

Hi team — looping you in for the implementation kickoff with BlueHarbor (Elena/Mike). They went live on the trial and signed last week; procurement is finishing the PO. Objectives for this kickoff: create the customer project/namespace, seed a service account for inference traffic, provision the first API key and an admin invite (Elena/Mike), and document the rotation + KMS plan.

Quick context: BlueHarbor will be using Redwood Dedicated in us-west for their production workloads. They have Okta SSO and want KMS integration (they prefer AWS KMS but can confirm). Expected initial token throughput is modest (50k tokens/day) but they will ramp in Q3.

Please see attached: blueharbor-onboard-checklist.xlsx and ns-seed-template.csv for the seed values.

Requested next steps: 
- Sofia: lead the kickoff and schedule a 30-min technical handoff with BlueHarbor (this week if possible).
- Jonas: prepare namespace and pre-seed the service account + key stub.
- Mina: prepare SOC2 and network info bundle for procurement.

Elena/Mike: please confirm preferred KMS (AWS/GCP) and whether you need IP allowlist or static egress. Also share the list of initial admins (emails) you want invited.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: blueharbor-onboard-checklist.xlsx, ns-seed-template.csv
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueHarbor initial namespace seed & access kickoff

Thanks Monica — happy to take point.

A few quick clarifications before I book the call: 
- Proposed times: Thu 2028-05-31 10:00am PT or Thu 2:00pm PT. Which works for BlueHarbor?
- KMS: we'll support AWS KMS or GCP KMS for key wrapping. If they prefer AWS, we'll need the AWS KMS key ARN and IAM principal for ledgering.
- SSO: you mentioned Okta — do they plan SCIM provisioning or just OIDC SSO? SCIM requires additional admin setup from their side.
- IP allowlist/static egress: if they need a static egress IP we should note that for Dedicated capacity.

Jonas — once you have the namespace created, please seed a service account named exactly: bh-infer-sa and include a short README with the limited-scope key (avoid putting secret material in the thread). Reference the ns-seed-template.csv for project IDs.

I'll draft the meeting agenda and include an action tracker.

— Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Park <elena.park@blueharbor.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Chen <mike.chen@blueharbor.com>, Procurement <procurement@blueharbor.com>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueHarbor initial namespace seed & access kickoff

Thanks Monica and Sofia — excited to get started. A few answers inline: 
- KMS: AWS KMS works best for us. I'll ask our infra lead to share the KMS key ARN before the call.
- SSO: We're planning to use Okta OIDC for now; SCIM is a follow-up (we can do SCIM in parallel but prefer to get OIDC in place first).
- IP allowlist: not required for the MVP. We will evaluate static egress later.

Initial admins to invite: Elena Park <elena.park@blueharbor.com>, Mike Chen <mike.chen@blueharbor.com>, L. Ramirez <laura.ramirez@blueharbor.com>.

Procurement has the PO template attached (PO_template_BlueHarbor.pdf). They will return an executed PO by end of week.

Would Thu 10:00am PT work? We can take a 30-min slot to cover namespace, API key lifecycle, and Okta setup.

On Tue, May 30, 2028 at 09:12 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi team — looping you in for the implementation kickoff with BlueHarbor (Elena/Mike).
> ...

Regards,
Elena Park
Director of Platform Engineering, BlueHarbor Health
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BlueHarbor initial namespace seed & access kickoff

Quick ops update: I've created the project/namespace: blueharbor-prod (internal id: ns-7842) and pre-seeded the service account bh-infer-sa.

What I did: 
- Created service account: bh-infer-sa (role: inference-runtime-client, limited billing view).
- Uploaded key stub to onboarding folder (bh-infer-sa-key.json) — this is a placeholder file; actual key material will be exchanged via secure file transfer.
- Populated ns-seed-template.csv with project ids and brief notes.

Attachments (stubs): bh-infer-sa-key.json (do not paste secrets in email), ns-seed-template.csv.

Next for me: once we confirm KMS ARN and Okta flow I'll wire up KMS wrapping and create the initial API credential with a short TTL for first-run (we'll rotate after the call).

— Jonas
Platform Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@blueharbor.com>, Mike Chen <mike.chen@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: BlueHarbor kickoff — agenda + link

Elena/Mike — thanks for confirming. Thu 2028-05-31 10:00am PT is confirmed. Meeting invite sent (30 min). Agenda (high level):
1) Introductions & success criteria (5m)
2) Namespace/roles & seeded service account overview (Jonas) (7m)
3) API key lifecycle, KMS wrapping, and rotation plan (Sofia) (8m)
4) Okta OIDC flow quickstart & SCIM next steps (Mina) (6m)
5) Actions, PO status, and follow-ups (4m)

Pre-reads and links: 
- Onboarding checklist 
- Seed template (I've populated with the IDs Jonas created) 
- HubSpot deal: https://redwood.hubspot.com/deal/DH-7642

Action items before the call: 
- BlueHarbor: share AWS KMS key ARN and confirm final admin emails (Elena).
- Procurement: confirm PO return ETA (Procurement@blueharbor.com).
- Jonas: prepare a short README for bh-infer-sa usage and the secure key exchange method.

We'll keep key material off email (Jonas will share transfer instructions). If you need a DocuSign or corporate onboarding form, flag it and we'll route.

See you Thu — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
